_comment: Phase 1 label-efficiency matrix (eval/matrix.py). Teacher = DINOv3-SAT (frozen, cls/clsmp/cls4/cls4mp
views selected on val). flux-pretrained = frozen FLUX.1-dev, ens8 oneshot multi-block caches, block k
fixed per dataset at the value eval.sweep selected on the official val split at 100 % labels over the
so2sat 28, forestnet 56, bigearthnet 12. (Until 2026-10-13 the spec carried the older single-block
sweep's blocks 24/38/54/54 for brick-kiln/pv4ger/forestnet/bigearthnet; those FLUX cells were moved to
results/matrix/stale/ and recomputed.) Timestep candidates (t100..t900, concat) and C
are selected on val per cell. Fractions are of the official train split; val/test are the full
official splits. Metrics: top-1, micro-F1 for m_bigearthnet; never averaged across datasets.

C grid 2026-10-13b: 1e-6..1 extended to 10 and 100 after 40/216 cells (18.5 %) selected the C=1 edge (all m_bigearthnet 1 % cells; dinov3-sat m_bigearthnet f0.01 s0 val 0.487 at C=1 vs 0.521 at C=10). The matrix 100 % DINO cells therefore use a 9-value grid, the banked official wide probe a 7-value one: the matrix number can only be >= on val, and is the one to quote for the matrix.
